blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Calvin Oftana is skipping Gilas Pilipinas’ campaign in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers. Coach Tim Cone said Oftana won’t be suiting for the crucial games against Syria and Iran later this month in Seremban, Malaysia with his wife Ena due to give birth. The Oftana couple is expecting their second child. His absence prompted Cone to call up Rhenz Abando, who became a surprise addition to Gilas’ 12-man roster which was announced on Wednesday. “His wife is delivering at the end of the month so he begged off, so he was part of the original […]...
